title: Thiên Mụ Temple
scope: The principal Thiên Mụ Temple buildings along the ridge above the Perfume River, including the Phước Duyên Tower, adjoining pavilions, Tam Quan gate, Đại Hùng Hall, rear axial buildings and memorial stupa.
limitations: Tower height and building plan are documented. Section heights of the roofed halls, eave ornaments and the smaller pavilion details are estimated.
